title: The Act of God Clause
logline: When an insurer invokes cosmic hazard exemptions to refuse indemnity for a vaporized hauler, the surviving navigator hires a pilot to prove a station beacon was deliberately misaligned.

roles.description: Surviving navigator of the vaporized hauler, obsessed with disproving the insurer's natural hazard ruling.
Regional underwriting manager whose quarterly bonus depends on keeping total-loss payouts under threshold.
Night-shift navigational beacon tech who took a side payment to let a navigation buoy drift.
A solar-facing hazard buoy marking the flare boundary between the inner system and the haulage lane.
A heavily paneled corporate claims lounge inside the upper station ring.

public_situation: An underwriting cartel in {system} classifies the destruction of a freight hauler as an uninsurable cosmic flare accident.
private_truth: {role:relay_technician} accepted a corporate payoff to delay recalibrating the warning buoy, steering ships into the coronal flare zone.

beats.public_change: Navigational warnings across {system} are updated with a retroactive notice blaming solar radiation for lost transit craft.

missions.reason: The navigator needs a spectral scan of the buoy's thruster housing to prove its orientation gyros were intentionally disabled before the solar flare.
missions.private_fact: The navigator was asleep during the emergency warning sirens and carries agonizing survivor guilt over the crew's demise.

beats.public_change: {role:claims_director} imposes a surprise forensic filing surcharge on all outstanding casualty disputes.

missions.reason: The director demands certified thorium ore delivered to run the office's actuarial processing reactors before opening a claim appeal window.
missions.private_fact: The director already shredded two internal safety memos warning that the hazard buoy had shifted fifteen degrees off axis.

beats.public_change: The station magistrate schedules a summary dismissal hearing to close the hauler's casualty file forever.

missions.reason: The navigator asks the pilot to purchase the technician's pawned maintenance slate from a black-market broker to present at the tribunal.
missions.private_fact: The maintenance slate contains recorded voice memos confirming the technician received payoffs to ignore drift alerts.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds documented proof that the hazard buoy was deliberately sabotaged, voiding the insurer's Act of God defense.

options.label: Present the evidence at the public hearing, forcing full wrongful death indemnity and ousting the director
Accept the director's private settlement offering lifetime medical stipends for surviving families in exchange for silence
Sell the buoy tampering evidence to a rival transport guild seeking to break the insurer's transit monopoly

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot reveals the buoy tampering at the tribunal.
resolutions.summary: Underwriters are forced to pay full indemnity to the victims' families; {role:claims_director} is dismissed in disgrace and {role:bereaved_navigator} finds closure.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved a fatal solar flare disaster was caused by a corporate hazard cover-up.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot and navigator accept the director's private settlement.
resolutions.summary: {role:claims_director} seals the buoy logs and pays out quiet survivor pensions; {role:bereaved_navigator} leaves the system with guaranteed financial security.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the maintenance records to a rival guild.
resolutions.summary: Rival haulers sue the underwriting cartel into bankruptcy over systemic buoy neglect; transit premiums spike across {system}.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails the missions or abandons the contracts.
resolutions.summary: The tribunal upholds the Act of God exemption; {role:bereaved_navigator} is evicted from the docks while {role:claims_director} earns a quarterly bonus.

loose_threads.detail: The hazard buoy calibration contract was renewed by an unregistered holding company with no registered corporate address.
The insurer casualty escrow account transferred four million credits to a debt clearinghouse the morning before the flare.

radio_hooks: Underwriting syndicate invokes natural catastrophe exemption following freighter loss in {system}.
Coronal flare warning buoy telemetry placed under temporary administrative seal.
Bereaved shipping families rally outside claims office demanding independent review.

voice_direction.bereaved_navigator: Strained, intense, obsessively reciting orbital coordinates in a low, furious monotone.
voice_direction.claims_director: Polite, patronizing, smoothly deflecting moral accusations with polite corporate condolences and procedural delays.
voice_direction.relay_technician: Defensive, evasive, constantly shifting blame to solar interference and demanding payment upfront.
